title: Reduce the scaled P104 output correction from 569 gates to 74
body:
PR6529 ends with 569 scalar gates to repair its two scaled transport changes. This package replaces that block with **74 ADDs**, with exactly the same operator on all 799 fields. It uses and restores two existing public fields, with no added owned field or native map.

The correction costs **696** source real scalar units instead of 5658. The complete local allowance falls **137218→132256**, saving **4962 per native call**, or **89316 across eighteen calls**. The source paid/productive profiles and conditional kappa are unchanged.

The exact rank-two factorization has four zero pairings. Two invariant forms permit direct delivery and exact public-pivot restoration. The search covers all 78,408 declared pivot, signed dyadic scale and direction-order choices; all 44 minimum programs have the same checked matrix. This is a finite optimum, not a global linear-circuit minimum. The unrestricted target-write lower bound is 28.

Evidence at `8bc9f991afe9fde83700ff86e520230eaa4595e7`: warning-strict CPython3.12.13 normal/optimized registered replay; complete forward scalar replay; all 799 dense reverse columns (638401 positions); all 799 independent correction columns; 74 omission and 74 doubling controls; three full-word controls, five invalid inputs and six actual source-byte corruptions. Committed bytes/modes, official export, and both sealed read-only, Git-free, empty-PATH replays pass. Hosted planning and replay passed at the published head: [run 41574763684](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41574763684).

Correction-only prefix norm rises 21→28. Exact complete-word prefix norm remains 838 and maximum coefficient magnitude remains 17. Native/owned event subsequences and all boundary headers are byte-equivalent as parsed data. Native phases, physical caller, compiler, rounding/tape and outer proofs are retained source obligations, not rerun here. No selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed. The shallow checkout does not certify full-history ancestry.

Start with [PROOF.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8bc9f991afe9fde83700ff86e520230eaa4595e7/research/p104-sparse-output-correction/PROOF.md), [RESULT.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8bc9f991afe9fde83700ff86e520230eaa4595e7/research/p104-sparse-output-correction/RESULT.json), and the [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19365729). Main 7c49fe32 and revision 8/selected6030 were refreshed. Overlap covered 485 open PRs and 6,475 Discussion records; sparse local notes, unpublished work and later changes remain limits.

Credit PR6529 at 44b0d0e8961201ac1656490b4384a7752e1cd9c5, Rohan Arun's PR6399 donor merge, Erwan L.'s PR6453, DreamingOfClouds, Cinna Davis, David Arias, Gareth Davidson, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cao Yifan and all retained authors. Original files, hashes and notices are retained. Classical low-rank algebra is not claimed as new. New factorization, program, proof and checks: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. Independent scientific review remains open. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge or closure requested.
